title: Font weights
description: Only the weights the Visual direction prototype uses. Bricolage runs 400 to 800 (heading 800, display-secondary 700, lead 400), Geist 400 to 700 (body 400, strong 700), Geist Mono is 500 only (label), Fraunces Italic is 400 only (emphasis). display-secondary and lead are not applied yet; ticket 032 does that. Proposed 2026-11-17, owner to approve.
